clips.title: The story
paras: Data Hoarders is a task given by Jemma Quikswitch, an exiled gnome residing in Ironforge. During the desperate evacuation of Gnomeregan, she copied her family's most prized archives onto punch cards, only to lose several in the freezing drifts outside the city gates. Recovering these lost data cards means salvaging everything from advanced naval engineering schematics to irreplaceable family recipes.

When the trogg invasion and subsequent radiation disaster forced the gnomes out of Gnomeregan, thousands fled with whatever belongings they could snatch up in the chaos. Jemma Quikswitch took the prudent step of transcribing generations of family knowledge into physical punch card archives. Tragically, a damaged satchel spilled several key cards into the snowfields surrounding the fallen city. Without these missing punch cards, the remaining data registers as indecipherable gibberish, threatening to erase her family's intellectual legacy.

Gnomish data archives reflect the peculiar breadth of their civilization's priorities. The Quikswitch family records include profound arcanotechnical field equations, vital Second War submarine hull blueprints, and Grandma Quikswitch's secret chili recipe. To an outsider, combining military engineering with household cooking might seem odd, but to surviving refugees in Ironforge, preserving domestic comforts matters just as much as preserving technological marvels.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... Our greatest accomplishments are in those files.
It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.
The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...

clips.title: Progress
paras: How is the data retrieval progressing?

clips.title: Completion
paras: These cards seem a bit damp... But I can work with this! Thank you, friend!
